reason: The hypothesis directly transfers the Y2O3 dispersion strengthening approach, already demonstrated for NiCoCr-based superalloys and MPEAs in P17 and P19, to a Ti-Ni-based HEA system. The mechanism (grain boundary pinning and dislocation obstacle) is taken word-for-word from those passages, and the predicted outcome mirrors their reported results. No new mechanistic insight, combination of disparate findings, or resolution of a literature gap is proposed; it is a straightforward application of a known intervention to a new but closely related alloy family without justification for why it should work there.
